interface.name: rix_remote_input_manager_v1
interface.description: Only an explicitly enabled remote-input extension can bind this global through its inherited private Wayland connection. The extension must obtain local RemoteDesktop consent before creating a session. Ordinary clients and login displays never receive this global. Session locking revokes sessions.

interface.name: rix_remote_input_session_v1

description.summary: Remote input owned by one consented session

interface.description: Input is processed through the compositor seat. Keys and buttons held by this session are released when the session is destroyed, disconnected, or revoked, without releasing input held by local devices or other sessions. Closed sessions are inert and must be destroyed. Motion coordinates and deltas are in logical compositor coordinates. Linux evdev codes are used.

entry.name: limit
entry.summary: session or input rate limit reached

event.name: unsupported_keysym

description.summary: Symbol cannot be represented by the active keymap

event.description: The rejected symbol was not injected. The session remains active. A client must report this failure to its caller rather than claim success. Other keys, physical input, and the keyboard map remain unchanged.
